causal_discipline.rule: Literature effect sizes remain evidence metadata and are not runtime propagation weights.

explicit_non_edges.rationale: Emotion and motivation interact with language, but current C2 nodes represent receiver affect/motivation whereas available C6 evidence often concerns affective lexical properties or language stimuli. No direct node-to-node edge is promoted to avoid construct conflation.

Social norms and identity clearly influence behavior broadly, but current C4 nodes are specific judgment/choice mechanisms. A generic social-to-decision edge would be too coarse; effects should route through future construct-matched choice nodes or specific experiments.

boundaries: Edge density is not a quality target.
Pairs can close with explicit insufficient-evidence/non-edge decisions.
Provisional edges may guide research/retrieval but must not be treated as settled causal rules.
Within-core hierarchy and node definitions remain usable even when a node has no cross-core edge.
